details: Solana (SOL) Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded $10.26 million in weekly inflows from August 10-15, marking the highest among all crypto ETFs during the period. Chainlink (LINK) surged by 5.17%, reaching its highest price since May, accompanied by a 120% increase in trading volume. Shiba Inu (SHIB) also showed stronger performance compared to other major assets, while Bitcoin and Ethereum remained relatively stable.
title: Solana ETFs Lead Weekly Inflows; LINK & SHIB Outperform

details: Bitcoin (BTC) is trading around $62,900, Ethereum (ETH) near $1,878, and XRP hovers at the key $1.00 level. The crypto market remains largely range-bound as traders anticipate the release of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting minutes on August 19 and a White House meeting with crypto executives. Low trading volumes and geopolitical uncertainties are contributing to the lack of decisive price movements.
title: BTC, ETH, XRP Stall Ahead of FOMC Minutes and White House Meeting

details: Two major financial institutions, each managing over $1 trillion in assets, have approved crypto products this summer. This signals a significant shift in traditional finance (TradFi) from resisting to actively enabling digital assets. Industry leaders view this as a structural change driven by client demand and increasing regulatory clarity, fostering a blend of traditional and decentralized finance.
title: TradFi Giants Embrace Crypto, Ending "Long Bitcoin, Short Bankers" Era

details: XRP has fallen below the $1 support level twice within the past five days and is currently trading nearly 46% below its January price. The upcoming cloture vote for the CLARITY Act in the Senate is considered a crucial catalyst for XRP. A successful passage could lead to a rally towards $1.50, while a failure to hold $1 could see the price drop to around $0.70.
title: XRP's $1 Support Tested as CLARITY Act Vote Approaches

details: World Liberty Financial (WLFI), a company backed by Donald Trump, has received conditional approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for its USD1 stablecoin. This regulatory milestone led to a 3% rise in WLFI's stock following the announcement.
title: Trump-Backed World Liberty Financial Gets USD1 Stablecoin Bank Charter

details: Bullish, the parent company of CoinDesk Indices, released its Q2 2026 financial results. A key highlight was the launch of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana exchange-traded products (ETPs) by Morgan Stanley, utilizing CoinDesk's benchmarks. These new ETPs attracted over $400 million in inflows during the second quarter.
title: Bullish Q2 Results; Morgan Stanley Launches BTC, ETH, SOL ETPs
